title: Affine thickness: Patterns and a Gap Lemma
summary: A new notion of thickness for subsets of $B[0,1]\subset \mathbb{R}^n$ called affine thickness is defined; this notion of thickness is a generalisation of Falconer-Yavicoli thickness and is adapted to be used in the study of certain sets with affine cut outs. Thick sets are proven to be winning for the matrix potential game introduced in (arXiv:2508.11577) and as an application we can prove that for a thick set, there exists $M\in\mathbb{N}$ depending on the thickness of the set, such that the set contains a homothetic copy of every finite set with at most $M$ elements.
